title: This baby shark adopted a whole family of cats
description: Jeff faces down an alley cat, then Kate almost serves him at Sharksgiving dinner.
hook_note: A tiny shark scratching his head next to a fish sets up the softest, weirdest cat rescue arc.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: This is Jeff the Land Shark, making his usual pilgrimage to the fish shop.

segments.text: This is Jeff the Land Shark, making his usual pilgrimage to the fish shop.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: The owner slips him a fish, and the little guy is down bad in love with it.

segments.text: The owner slips him a fish, and the little guy is down bad in love with it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: But an alley cat pulls up and eyes that fish like it's already hers.

segments.text: But an alley cat pulls up and eyes that fish like it's already hers.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: So the GOAT roars, and the cat and a dog both scatter for their lives.

segments.text: So the GOAT roars, and the cat and a dog both scatter for their lives.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: But then he finds that same cat curled up cold in the alley, and softens right up.

segments.text: But then he finds that same cat curled up cold in the alley, and softens right up.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Turns out she's got three kittens, so the little menace starts feeding them all.

segments.text: Turns out she's got three kittens, so the little menace starts feeding them all.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And the whole family ends up asleep on Jeff himself, an absolute clutch of a shark.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Later, it's Sharksgiving, and Jeff keeps trying to raid Kate's roasting oven.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: His owner Kate Bishop keeps pointing at the no-chicken sign, breaking his little heart.

segments.text: His owner Kate Bishop keeps pointing at the no-chicken sign, breaking his little heart.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: So the menace sneaks onto a serving plate and passes out among the roasted vegetables.

segments.text: So the menace sneaks onto a serving plate and passes out among the roasted vegetables.

shots.line: The whole table of heroes absolutely loses it thinking Jeff is dinner.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: But the GOAT was just here for the food, mouth stuffed, happiest shark alive.
